title: Require contextual explanations at development completion

requirement.summary: Every completed development handoff must explain the result plainly, identify its upstream and downstream connections, and state its project-wide value.

objective.rationale: A consistent completion explanation helps the human product owner understand each slice as part of the product system instead of receiving only implementation details and test counts.

goal: Add a durable repository instruction and regression test for plain-language, upstream, downstream, and project-value completion explanations.
non_goals: Do not make further changes to product runtime behavior, CLI behavior, release identity, public documentation, or consumer templates; their existing uncommitted paths remain listed only so the combined validated working copy can be inspected without hiding the preceding completed slice.
Do not require invented upstream or downstream relationships when none is established.
Do not commit, push, publish, release, deploy, or modify an external system.
acceptance_signals: AGENTS.md requires every completed development handoff to explain what was built in plain language, its upstream connection, its downstream connection, and its value to the overall project.
The guidance requires explicit none, foundation, unknown, or not-yet-decided wording instead of inventing a relationship.
A focused regression test protects the required completion explanation contract.
The current task, scope, repository, and diff checks pass.

items: Vague wording could produce repetitive technical summaries instead of the requested product context.
Forcing a connection where none exists could create false roadmap claims.

stop_conditions: Stop if the guidance would require inventing roadmap commitments or relationships not supported by repository evidence.
Stop before any runtime, release, consumer-template, Git, or external-system change.

decision.rationale: The completion communication guidance and its regression test are complete. The task is paused for routing hygiene after the human review selected the vendor-neutral host approval contract as the next real need.
